title: ExtlRecShrCnctAccnt - Data API
description: Represents an association between an account and an external record share connection for Partner Connect. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

AccountId.description: ID of the account. This field is a relationship field.

ExtlRecShrCnctId.description: ID of the ExtlRecShrCnct record. This field is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

special_access_rules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.
